---
title: "Borg/Vorta"
---

Install BorgBackup and the optional Vorta GUI for encrypted, versioned workstation backups. The `borg_vorta` role installs the tools only; it does not create repositories, store credentials, choose destinations, or schedule backups.

```sh
ansible-playbook -i inventory -K playbooks/lab-stack.yml --tags borg_vorta
```

::: {.callout-manual}
**🔧 Manual setup and configuration**

Create or reconnect backup repositories and configure credentials, destinations, retention, and schedules in Vorta or Borg. Then follow the recurring backup and restore checks in [Backup and sync](backup.html).
:::

::: {.callout-check}
**✅ Check**

```sh
borg --version
flatpak info com.borgbase.Vorta
```
:::
